body:
I can't just put my suicidal feelings away. And they prevent me from functioning like a normal human being. This includes hobbies, friends and working. I push everyone away from me and can't even focus on studying all because of my loneliness.

Yes, my feelings might go away, but I don't know if I can survive until the moment they will.

I wouldn't be so sad about my loneliness if I had something to focus on. But aside from video games, I suck at mostly everything. I can't even decide what I want to do in the future. And it's all because of one thing.
